# Timerpad / 타이머패드

> A free, ad-free local HIIT + Pomodoro + stopwatch with no account.
> Countdown, editable Pomodoro rounds, editable HIIT/Tabata intervals,
> stopwatch with laps, saved routines, fullscreen, wake lock, short cue
> sounds, drift-corrected timing and a JSON backup.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://timerpad.try-dabble.com/
Routines and preferences stay in this browser on this device. No accounts,
no sign-in, no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no in-app purchases,
no subscription, no locked presets. Export a JSON backup to survive a
reinstall or move phones.

## Pages

- [Home](https://timerpad.try-dabble.com/): The timer
- [Privacy](https://timerpad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://timerpad.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/en/guides/timerpad): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Countdown timer with hours, minutes and seconds
- Pomodoro rounds: work, rest, long rest, rounds and long-break spacing are all editable
- Interval / HIIT / Tabata: every step (kind, seconds, optional name) and round count is editable
- Stopwatch with laps
- Save, load and delete routines
- Fullscreen and screen wake lock
- Short cue sounds that do not hijack music
- Drift-corrected timing that keeps ticking when the tab is backgrounded as much as the browser allows
- Stop and reset stay available mid-workout
- JSON export / import; delete all data
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
